description: 健保門診及住院就診人次統計-COVID-19 [pandemic] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 衛生福利部疾病管制署. 各縣市、年齡別、年週之COVID-19健保門診及住院就診人次統計表，其中COVID-19採國際疾病分類第10版(ICD-10)代碼為「U07. 1」者。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 衛生福利部疾病管制署. Its tags are 就醫. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json. The portal shows 2026-03-25 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
